description: PhosphoRLIE extraction schema — one PTM regulatory event per record

pmid.description: PubMed ID of the source article

record.description: Record identifier (for multi-event articles; empty string for single-record)

relation_exists.description: Whether an eligible PTM regulatory relation exists in the text

evidence_text.description: The exact sentence(s) providing evidence for the PTM event

ptm_target.description: The focal protein that undergoes PTM in this event

ptm_target_role.description: Whether the PTM target acts as an enzyme or substrate in this event

modification_sites.description: PTM modification sites (e.g., ['S186', 'Y490'] for phosphorylation, ['K382'] for acetylation)

upstream_enzyme.description: The upstream enzyme that catalyzes the PTM (if explicitly stated for the same focal event)

ptm_origin.description: Origin of the PTM: self-modification, catalyzed by an upstream enzyme, or unknown

primary_agent.description: The primary intervention agent (drug, compound, antibody, etc.)

agent_validity.description: Whether the agent is a valid intervention or an assay/detection material

disease.description: Disease entity explicitly stated in the text

cancer_type.description: Broad cancer type when applicable (e.g., 'breast cancer', 'lung cancer')

cancer_subtype.description: Specific cancer subtype only when explicitly stated (e.g., 'lung adenocarcinoma', 'TNBC')

cell_lines.description: Cell lines used in the experiment

species_is_human.description: Whether the study involves human samples

trigger_phrase.description: Original phrase from text indicating the PTM regulatory relation

regulation_mode.description: Whether the PTM event enhances, impairs, or is associated with the effect

relationship.description: Human-readable summary of the complete PTM-regulatory relationship

confidence.description: Confidence score: 9-10 explicit, 7-8 strong, 5-6 probable, 3-4 weak, 0-2 unsupported

needs_manual_review.description: Whether this record requires manual expert review

review_reasons.description: Specific reasons why manual review is needed

reviewer_notes.description: Semicolon-separated list of corrections made during the review phase
